paper-figures/tritoncast.webp.description: Global 2 m air temperature (K) for the 7-day forecast valid at 12:00 UTC on 8 January 2020. ERA5 is on the left and TritonCast is on the right. Both views use the same color scale (220–320 K). The forecast time stays fixed as the globes turn.
paper-figures/tritoncast.webp.data: Paired author experiment arrays t2m_labels.npy (ERA5) and t2m_predictions.npy (TritonCast), 1-degree grid, day index 6. Initialized 1 January 2020 at 12:00 UTC. Both globe textures are bilinearly sampled from these unnormalized Kelvin fields.

paper-figures/oneforecast.webp.description: OneForecast’s graph encoder, message-passing module, decoder, and global and regional forecast pathways.

paper-figures/ai-goms.webp.description: AI-GOMS ocean backbone with masked pretraining and downstream task modules.

paper-figures/pnp-corrector.webp.description: Comparison of uncoupled forecasts, coupled error accumulation, and PnP-Corrector’s residual correction.

paper-figures/neuralom.webp.description: NeuralOM’s progressive residual correction, physics-guided graph network, and global ocean rollout.

paper-figures/nuwadynamics.webp.description: NuwaDynamics’ causal patch discovery and causal model update stages.

paper-figures/prometheus.webp.description: DGODE extracts local state and environment features and uses them to condition a graph ODE.

paper-figures/pastnet.webp.description: PastNet combines a Fourier-based physics-guided module with a discrete spatiotemporal module for video prediction.

paper-figures/dino.webp.description: DINO advances a latent physical field through a global corrector, a local refiner, and a residual update.

paper-figures/frequency-distillation.web.description: SDKD pretrains a frequency-decoupled teacher, distills it into a smaller student model, and uses the student for forecasting.

paper-figures/videogaia.webp.description: VideoGAIA benchmark construction pipeline for agentic video understanding.

paper-figures/orchestra-o1.webp.description: Orchestra-o1 framework for coordinating specialized agents across modalities.

paper-figures/safer-vlm.webp.description: SaFeR-VLM framework for safety-aware rollouts, data curation and multimodal reward modeling.
